M0.estimand: the size of ONE burn of a class, from the committed ledgers. NOT remaining propellant; no propellant, mass or consumables figure is read or computed.

native.unit: deg/day of drift the stop burn nulls

C1_relocation_stop_geo.floorNote: the published 0.010 deg/day drift-change floor truncates this distribution from below; p5 is as much the floor as the objects

weighting.why: the subset is enriched: every positive plus a uniform sample of the rest, so unweighted quantiles would describe the sample, not the 226,422-row population

C2_any_drift_change_geo.recall: UNMEASURED: 33% of T8a's events had no visible initiating flag; this is a distribution over the burns the detector saw and nothing here estimates the ones it did not

C2a_drift_change_cluster1.source: same, cluster == 1 (T8d taxonomy, primary-arm resolvable rows only)

C2b_drift_change_cluster0.source: same, cluster == 0 (T8d taxonomy, primary-arm resolvable rows only)

C3_north_south_keeping_geo.population: data/propulsion-catalog-v1.json, commercial-civil only -- inherited from T10b, not widened here

C4_east_west_keeping_geo.recall: 1.81% median detected recall (T10c): the detected distribution is over the LARGEST burns only and is detectability-selected

C5_transfer_legs.population: data/propulsion-catalog-v1.json, commercial-civil only -- inherited from T10a/T10d, not widened here

daFromPhaseRate.unit: km of |delta a| implied by phaseRateMaxDegPerDay

C6i_leo_plane_change_in_campaign.verdict: BLINDED CHANNEL -- not a zero-sized burn. T8b's plane threshold is max(5 sigma_theta, 0.01 deg) = 3.5 deg because the registered sigma_theta came back 145x too large (T8b 2.3); the channel is essentially switched off, so no plane-change size distribution exists to quantile.

extract.source: cached T8a extract, three numbers asserted

armA.note: each horizon on its own qualifying set, exactly the +30 d method

armB.note: triggers qualifying at every primary horizon; the only arm in which growth is a statement about propagation rather than about which objects stayed quiet

slotSpacing.definition: stationed = current element set inside the merge window, >= 30 d of history, |drift| <= 0.020 deg/day (the lane's own eligibility proxy)
slotSpacing.caveat: a description of the belt as the archive's last epoch finds it; NOT a regulatory slot plan and not a physical constant

crossings.note: every bar here is a screen, not a law: none of them says the propagation becomes wrong at a horizon, only that its error stops being small compared with the quantity the layer wants to resolve

M2.covariateNote: association only: no functional form is fitted and no drag model is built. LEO drag remains unmodelled and this measurement does not discharge that.

designArithmeticUnderTest.claim: design 2.5: sigma_n = 6.27e-5 rev/day implies 2.0 deg of phase at 90 d at the median
